off.title: Read-only: no agent configured.
hero.off_body: You can't ask new questions, but the history stays open. Pick a conversation on the left: each question keeps its steps, SPARQL queries, tokens, charts, map and chronology, as the trace recorded them.
hero.title: Ask a question and watch the agent look for the answer.
hero.body: Your agent queries the graph through the ster MCP server. Every step, every SPARQL query and every token spent shows up in the timeline.
ex.1: What does the ontology contain? Give me an overview.
ex.2: How many individuals does each class have?
ex.3: Which properties does the ontology define, and on which classes?
ex.4: Show me ten individuals with their labels.
viz.label: Visualize
viz.choose: Several charts fit these results. Which one should be shown?
viz.no_lib: Chart unavailable (library not loaded). Use the table.
why.bar_many: The 15 largest values, the rest grouped
map.label: ster map
map.sub: {rows} · the map runs the agent's query
map.title: ster map of the results
map.one_place: These results point to a single place.
map.ask: Place these results on a map: give me a query that returns each entity concerned with its latitude and longitude.
frise.label: Chronology
frise.only_prov: These results only contain provenance dates ({n}).
map.named_one: These results name one place that can be drawn.
map.named_other: These results name {count} places that can be drawn.
frise.named_one: These results name one dated thing.
frise.ask: Put these results on a timeline: give me a query that returns each entity concerned with its IRI, its name and its date.
tl.title: Query timeline
tl.heading: Timeline
tl.empty: A question's timeline appears here: model steps, queries to ster, and tokens per step.
tl.question: Question
tl.cost_tip: Cost estimate reported by the agent for this question
tl.cache_tip: Context already cached, re-read on each call: {n} tokens. Not counted in new tokens.
tl.chips_tip: Context sent to the model: {n} tokens
dlg.title: Agent check
dlg.h_last: Last run of the active agent
dlg.none_title: No usable agent: the page is read-only
dlg.ster_instr_ok: ster gives its usage instructions to agents
dlg.last_none_hint: Ask a question to measure what the agent provides.
dlg.last_counts: “{prompt}” · {steps} step(s), {calls} tool call(s), {sparql} SPARQL, {traced} ster trace(s)
err.ster_start: ster did not start on port {port}.
dlg.none_how: To add one: put a recipe in agent_app/recipes/, or set ASK_AGENT_CMD to any command that prints its answer (see recipes/README.md).
dlg.recipe_missing: program not found on the PATH
dlg.out_text: plain text answer: queries come from ster's traces
dlg.verified: run for real by its author
dlg.measured: Measured on the last run: “–” means the run gave no way to tell, a cross means the agent did not report it.
lastcap.sparql_rows: SPARQL rows and durations (from ster's traces)
prob.no_done: No final event: the page shows no answer.
prob.no_ster_traces: The agent ran SPARQL queries but ster recorded no trace during the run: it may be talking to another ster. Check the agent's own configuration.
reason.missing_binary: “{binary}” was not found in the PATH.
reason.no_recipes: No agent recipe is installed and ASK_AGENT_CMD is not set.
reason.none_installed: None of the recipes' programs is on the PATH: {list}.
tl.no_usage: This agent does not report tokens or cost.
app.name: Ask the ontology
bridge.down_hint: The page's own server (agent_app/server.py) is not answering. Start it again with: python -m agent_app
reason.endpoint_down: The model server at {endpoint} does not answer.
reason.no_tool_model: The model server at {endpoint} has no model that can call tools (found: {models}). Pull one that can, for example llama3.1 or qwen2.5.
reason.model_not_capable: The model “{model}” cannot call tools. Models that can: {models}.
dlg.out_model: this page runs the model itself: steps and tokens are reported, cost is not
ster.hint_down: ster is not running. It starts on the next question.
changed.title: The graph changed since this conversation began.
changed.why: Earlier answers may no longer hold. Your next question starts a fresh agent session on the new graph, so the agent does not reuse what it learned about the old one.
turn.fresh: The graph changed: the agent started a fresh session on {name}.
composer.placeholder_readonly: From ster's traces: read-only. Start a new conversation to ask.
steps.heading: Steps ({count})
lost.title: ster was restarted since this conversation began.
lost.why: The agent's connection to ster is probably gone: it may answer that ster is disconnected even though ster shows as connected here. Start a new conversation to reconnect.
nocall.note: No call reached ster for this answer. If the agent says ster is disconnected, start a new conversation.
